items.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="young adult male"} leans casually against a weathered stone balustrade, his relaxed shoulders and shifted weight conveying candid ease. He is dressed in a {argument name="suit color" default="light grey"} tailored suit paired with a deep navy, unbuttoned open-collared shirt. His hair is cleanly slicked back with product, catching a gentle sheen. Behind aviator sunglasses, his gaze is focused sharply off-camera to the left, accompanied by a serious expression with his mouth slightly ajar as if caught mid-breath. His hands are loosely clasped at his waist; the left hand rests with fingers wrapped lightly over the right, its thumb extended forward, displaying a rectangular silver dress watch with a light blue-grey leather strap, while only the thumb and index knuckle of the right hand remain visible beneath. He is positioned in a deeply layered {argument name="location" default="outdoor lakeside terrace setting"}. In the bottom left foreground, vibrant crimson red geraniums and dark foliage burst from a worn black metal planter box on a railing. To his lower right in the midground, the weathered warm off-white plastered stone pillar, detailed with subtle scuffs and matte grey undertones, supports a classic stone urn planter filled with green shrubbery and a solitary white flower. Stretching out behind him, pristine slate blue lake water ripples with choppy surface texture, revealing a small white boat in the far-left distance. Rising steeply in the deep background are mountains densely carpeted in thriving forest green trees, heavily interspersed with small white houses and villas clinging to the hillside. The scene exudes a sophisticated, quiet luxury, bathed in cool, moody natural light from an overcast sky acting as a giant softbox. Diffused lighting pours gently from above, creating a low-contrast illumination that casts faint, soft-edged shadows beneath his suit lapels, under his hands, and provides subtle modeling on the right side of his face. Crisp specular highlights form soft reflections on the aviator lenses and cast a gentle sheen on the watch face. The color palette relies on desaturated cool greys, slate blues, and forest greens, sharply punctuated by the vivid crimson accents. Captured as tack-sharp, grain-free realistic digital editorial photography from a straight-on perspective, utilizing a 50mm to 85mm lens at an aperture between f/4 and f/5.6, creating a medium depth of field that keeps the subject crisply in focus while atmospheric haze slightly softens the distant mountains.
